GeneralPerks.Name: Acute Senses
GeneralPerks.Text: Choose one of the five senses: (sight,hearing,taste,touch, or smell) You gain the following benefits : An Edge when rolling an Alertness Skill Test for if your chosen sense can be applied. An Upshift on a non-Alertness test where your chosen sense can be applied. You can chooe this Perk up to five times; once for each sense.

GeneralPerks.Name: Additional Alt Mode
GeneralPerks.Text: Choose A chasis Tied to an Origin. You gain the alt mode benefits of that chasis as a second choice when you Convert. You cannot choose a Chassis whose Alt Mode Size is two Size Classes larger than the Alt Mode Size of your orignal Chassis unless you take the Size Change General Perk. When you gain a Perk taht applies to an Alt mode, choose which Alt Mode it applies to when you gain the Perk.

GeneralPerks.Name: All Out Attack
GeneralPerks.Text: During your turn, you can voluntariliy take a downshift on your attacks with Might, Finesse, or targeting. For each downshift you take, you deal 1 additional damage to a single target hit by the attack, but enenemies gain an equal number of Upshifts to attack you until the start of your next turn.
